name: charge-summary
title: Charge Summary
description: Shows today's amount, the first charge and renewal dates, taxes (added or included) and one-time credits upfront, and sums it up in one plain sentence of what you'll pay.

meta.summary: Shows what will be charged today, when the first and renewal charges happen and what taxes apply, so checkout has no surprise charges.
meta.server: Charge the amount your billing system computes, not the client's figures.
catches: A trial that turns into a charge, with the exact date
One-time credits or discounts that won't repeat at renewal
Taxes added on top versus already included
limits: Displays the lines and tax rates you pass; it doesn't calculate tax rules
Dates use the time zone you pass, or the visitor's
a11y: Wrapped in a region with an aria-label
Line items are a description list (<dl>)
Icons are aria-hidden; everything is stated in text
